source_boundary: The original contract's uncontracted_research_targets supplies provenance for these candidate expressions only. It did not admit them as executable inputs. No C03 axis may run until the owner adopts this candidate and a distinct successor contract seals the adopted statement.
candidate_statement: Assume the supplied conditional Taylor bound |Z-Z0-H0*s/c| <= M2*s^2/2, the accepted finite screen bound s*(1-eta) <= dA <= s*(1+eta), and the separately verified scalar dependency 0 <= eta <= etaL < 1. Derive FD1, FD2, and FD3 exactly over the declared real domain.

domains_and_units.Z: real dimensionless scalar evaluated at s
domains_and_units.Z0: real dimensionless absolute intercept retained without setting Z0=1
domains_and_units.dA: real, dA > 0, units length; positive screen-area-distance branch
domains_and_units.etaL: eta(Kc,L), real and dimensionless, with etaL < 1

neutral_definitions.eta_positive_curvature: For Kc > 0 and t > 0, eta(Kc,t) = sinh(sqrt(Kc)*t)/(sqrt(Kc)*t) - 1 using the positive square root.

derivation_dependencies.FD1: Triangle inequality plus abs(dA-s) <= s*eta, obtained from the accepted two-sided finite screen bound.
derivation_dependencies.FD2: FD1 plus s <= dA/(1-eta) <= dA/(1-etaL) and eta/(1-eta) <= etaL/(1-etaL).
derivation_dependencies.FD3: FD1 multiplied by c/dA, then dA >= s*(1-eta).

finite_screen_C02.admitted_use: The conditional finite inequality s*(1-eta) <= dA <= s*(1+eta) and its positive denominator consequences only.

eta_monotonicity_M01.admitted_use: For Kc >= 0 and 0 < s <= L, 0 <= eta(Kc,s) <= eta(Kc,L); the separate premise etaL < 1 is retained.

unchanged_meaning: The original C03 finite dA error algebra is retained.
The Taylor remainder and screen bounds remain supplied conditional premises rather than results.
Absolute Z0 is retained and the FD-INTERCEPT control is not removed.
The eta=1 boundary remains excluded by etaL < 1 and is not called a caustic result.
newly_explicit_if_adopted: Exact FD1, FD2, and FD3 left- and right-hand expressions.
etaL means eta(Kc,L), with its dependency on separately verified eta monotonicity.
All denominator, sign, unit, and positive dA branch conditions.
A distinct successor contract rather than mutation of the historical original contract.

excluded_from_successor_pass: Taylor regularity-to-remainder proof or derivation of the supplied M2 bound
Jacobi or Volterra existence, convergence, or curvature-to-majorization
owner_decision_required: Adopt these exact definitions, domains, branches, units, and dependency bindings as the permitted neutral inputs for a distinct CAS-07-C03 successor. Adoption authorizes contract preparation and four fresh sequential engine executions only; it does not itself validate C03 or any broader theorem.
